originalSourceText:
Q.6   Which combination most directly explains why ROS2 is suitable for autonomous
       navigation?

      (A) Modular architecture + sensor integration + real-time navigation

      (B) Building Editor + Model Editor + GUI plugins

      (C) Occupancy map + PGM format + XML

      (D) Gazebo rendering + RViz visualization + URDF

       Explanation: These are explicitly listed as reasons for using ROS2 for autonomous
       navigation.

      Refer slide4 of lecture 58: Demonstration in ROS
